review_description: Mine was a difficult design with particular overshadowing.The designer listened and took into account my specific needs and my concerns. They didn’t just cover my roof with panels and didn’t unnecessarily oversize  the system.The system was installed neatly and allowed me to have some control over placement for safer maintenance. They also ran conduit in an asthetic manner rather than the easiest route.Additionally I researched the best rated products & the brands selected were well rated and not cheap rubbish so I also felt comfortable with that decision.
